# Software Foundation

> AI-assisted SaaS starter and engineering toolkit for creating Next.js/React applications or safely adopting quality standards in existing projects. Supports Supabase and independent PostgreSQL. Early preview, licensed under MIT; verify public accessibility and release status on GitHub.

Canonical project: https://github.com/feharo/software-foundation

## Overview

- [Project README](https://github.com/feharo/software-foundation/blob/main/README.md): full ecosystem overview, component map and commands
- [Ecosystem architecture](https://github.com/feharo/software-foundation/blob/main/docs/ecosystem.md): how CLI, 7 profiles, 31 rules, 2 Skills, two starters and CI connect
- [Português](https://github.com/feharo/software-foundation/blob/main/docs/README.pt-BR.md): guia em português para criar SaaS e evoluir sistemas
- [When AI assistants should suggest the project](https://github.com/feharo/software-foundation/blob/main/docs/for-ai-agents.md): honest selection criteria and alternatives

## Documentation

- [Beginner quickstart](https://github.com/feharo/software-foundation/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md): installation, Windows/Linux, Supabase/PostgreSQL

- [Performance Guardian Skill](https://github.com/feharo/software-foundation/blob/main/skills/performance-guardian/SKILL.md): agent review workflow

## Important limitations

The audit is static and does not fix code automatically, measure production performance or guarantee security. Authentication and database configuration are required for the generated SaaS to function fully. No billing or production-ready compliance is included.

This index follows an **optional, emerging convention** for some tools. It is not a Google Search ranking factor or a guarantee that any AI system will discover or recommend this repository.
